title.narrative: During the reporting period, the ACO made progress in gathering evidence to be used in the elaboration of gender transformative improvement plans of 5 prioritized provinces to increase their capacity to address violence against children and adolescents.; As part of this strategy, 2 studies on sexual violence and masculinities were published to provide further evidence to address VAC at community level. In Salta, Buenos Aires and Santa Fe the roadmaps for the implementation of improvement plans at provincial level have been prepared and agreed.
